Frequently asked questions

Yes, all sessions are private and confidential, adhering to ethical and legal standards.

Yes, we provide both online and offline therapy sessions to suit your convenience

Yes, we provide internationally standardized assessments for mental health conditions, including ADHD, Autism, Anxiety, Depression, Personality Disorders, and Learning Disabilities.

Yes, we offer specialized therapy and support for neurodivergent individuals, ensuring accessibility, personalized care, and tailored interventions.

If you experience ongoing stress, anxiety, mood changes, difficulty coping with life events, or relationship struggles, therapy can provide valuable support.

We address anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship issues, stress, grief, career challenges, workplace burnout, and more.

Yes, we work with healthcare providers to offer integrated mental health care for individuals needing multi-disciplinary support.

Free · 3 minutes · private

Stressed, or burnt out? They need different things.

Our self-check gives you four separate scores — worry, mood, body and sleep, and burnout — because those four problems look identical from the outside and respond to completely different treatment. Your answers stay in your browser, and the 7-Day Reset Plan has a track for whichever one is heaviest.
